breakdown.reason: The generated specification still explicitly identifies and loads charged-defect folders (folders with '+' or '-' in the name) as a core step of the workflow. While it does pass charge=0 to the correction function, the data-loading approach continues to focus on charged-defect outputs rather than the ground truth's approach of generically loading all subfolders under Mg_Ga. The contradiction between using charged-defect outputs and computing a neutral-state correction is not properly resolved to match the ground truth.
